acquire_lock_with_context_manager: acquire a MongoDB lock using a context manager to protect a shared resource by key and owner
acquire_lock_with_timeout: acquire a MongoDB lock with retry and timeout handling for inter-application communication
release_lock_key: release a MongoDB lock for a specific key to free the resource for other owners
lock_git_branch: lock a git branch of a dataset on the hub for read/write with automatic TTL expiration
create_lock_document: create a Lock MongoDB document with key, owner, ttl, and auto-expiring indexes
